_help: EDIT ME. Everything players see comes from this file. After saving, press 'Reload game.json' on the host page (no restart needed). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
title: Midnight in Ravenholt
rules:
Welcome to Ravenholt. By day the town argues. By night the Mafia strikes.
The host will tell you when you may use your abilities. Stay in character!
_phaseLabels: Rename the phases players see. Keys must stay: lobby, discussion, action, voting, ended.

phaseLabels.lobby: Waiting for the game to start
phaseLabels.action: Night falls: use your abilities when the host calls you

_teams: Team ids used by characters below. 'color' tints the badge on the player's card.
_defaultCharacterId: Anyone left over after a random deal gets this character.

characters._help: COPY THIS BLOCK to add a character. id must be unique, lowercase, no spaces.
characters.name: Vincent 'The Don' Moretti
characters.tagline: Smiles at the front door, signs orders at the back.
characters.personality:
Charming, patient, never raises his voice. Speaks softly and expects to be obeyed. Hates loose ends.

Play him as: calm, polite, quietly threatening.
characters.description: Early 50s. Silver at the temples, immaculate charcoal suit, a pinky ring he turns when he's thinking. Owns the Lucky Fox Supper Club.
characters.story: Twenty years ago you built Ravenholt's underworld from a single backroom card game. Now an informant is feeding the police your secrets, and you have until the next full moon to find them.
characters.secrets:
Your fellow Mafia: (write names here at game start, or use the host's message button).
You win when the Mafia outnumber the town.

extra.title: Your alibi
extra.text: You were at the Supper Club all evening. Forty witnesses. All on your payroll.

abilities.label: Order a hit
abilities.description: Choose who the Mafia targets tonight.

characters.name: Dr. Evelyn Hart
characters.tagline: Sworn to save everyone, even the ones she shouldn't.
characters.personality: Warm, anxious, a chronic over-explainer. Gets flustered when accused.
characters.description: Late 30s. Round glasses, leather bag, ink on her fingers. Runs the only clinic in town.
characters.story: You've patched up half the town, including a few men you suspect aren't builders. You've never asked how they were hurt. Tonight that might change.
characters.secrets: You may NOT protect the same person two nights in a row (host enforces this).

abilities.label: Protect a patient
abilities.description: Choose someone to shield from harm tonight. You may choose yourself.

characters.name: Inspector Sam Calloway
characters.tagline: Three days from retirement and one case from a promotion.
characters.personality: Dry humor, tired eyes, always one question short of being rude.
characters.description: Mid 40s. Rumpled trench coat, notebook with a broken spine, coffee-stained everything.
characters.story: The last three disappearances share one detail nobody else has noticed. You can feel the answer. You just need the right suspect in front of you.
characters.secrets: The host will privately tell you the result of each investigation.

abilities.label: Investigate a suspect
abilities.description: Pick someone. The host will message you what you learn.

characters.name: Rosa 'Red' Delgado
characters.tagline: One bullet. One chance. No second guesses.
characters.personality: Blunt, impatient, and tired of waiting for the law to catch up.
characters.description: Early 30s. Red scarf, work boots, a cigarette she never lights. Former dockworker.
characters.story: The Mafia took your brother's boat, then your brother. You kept one bullet from his old revolver. You swore you'd use it exactly once.
characters.secrets: If you shoot a townsperson, the guilt will be on you. The host decides what happens.

abilities.label: Take the shot
abilities.description: You only have ONE bullet for the whole game.

characters.name: Ordinary Citizen
characters.tagline: No powers. A lot of opinions.
characters.personality: Make this up! Pick a trade, a quirk and a grudge from the host's list.
characters.description: You live in Ravenholt. You have a job, neighbors and suspicions.
characters.story: Something is wrong in town. You don't know what, but you know who you don't trust.
